from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class OtherComprehensiveIncome(BaseModel):
    """One Other Comprehensive Income value reported in a company's financial statement."""
    source_type: str | None = Field(description="Which statement: 'balance_sheet_ending_balance' or 'income_statement_current_period'")
    value: float | None = Field(description="The numeric value as reported")
    unit: str | None = Field(description="Unit: 'yuan' for 元, 'million_yuan' for 百万元")
    quote: str = Field(description="Short phrase describing where this was found")

class CompanyFinancialData(BaseModel):
    """Financial data for one company from a single report."""
    company: str | None = Field(description="Company name as written in the report")
    report_period: str | None = Field(description="Report period, e.g., '2024年第一季度'")
    other_comprehensive_income: list[OtherComprehensiveIncome] = Field(description="List of OCI values found in this report")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_financial_data: list[CompanyFinancialData]
